quizGuardRationale: Direct pairwise hypotheses for independent review; symmetric and nontransitive. Titles and actual ordinary secondary senses, not POS or shared spelling alone, determine ambiguity.
響き compares acoustic sound and actual impression/feeling facets. 響く compares sounding/vibration and actual effect facets; not every communication or emotion word is inherited.
冷やす compares physical cooling and composure. 肝を冷やす is taught as a complete fright construction, not unrestricted fear synonymy or an automatic fear-word clique.
美容 compares genuine appearance/beauty-care facets, including makeup overlap. 表紙/カバー compares actual covering, not every surface or paper object.
標識's broad sign/marker label is assessed against individual actual mark, notation, signboard, signal, landmark and indication words. Those guards do not claim free substitution for road signs.
標準 compares criterion, level and ordinary/average facets. 標本 compares specimen/sample and classic-example facets, including actual ordinary secondary senses, not every scientific or living object.
評論 compares actual critique/critical judgment/appraisal, not an automatic plot-summary, insult, personal-reaction or report clique.

平仮名 compares actual broader kana/script/character labels, not katakana as an interchangeable script. ビルディング compares actual building labels and the same-family abbreviation; not the separate bill identity.
昼寝 compares actual sleep/dozing, not every rest or lunch-break word. 広げる compares actual broadening/unfolding/scattering and flourishing, including 開く's ordinary secondary ひらく reading.
広さ compares actual extent, width, size and dimensions, not every region named by English area. 広場's title concerns a plaza/square, not geometry or an automatic park/location clique.
広々 compares actual spacious/extensive meanings. 広める compares dissemination and broader extent without inheriting every physical unfolding/laying-out guard from 広げる.
No global semantic-uniqueness, unrestricted substitution, compiler-intent or bias-reduction guarantee follows. Inherited batch61 debt remains deferred.
